snippet.title: Bonespire | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Bonespire: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4955170/Bonespire/

If you were watching the Akupara Direct, you would have seen the Cryptmaster talking about his new game: Bonespire!

Oh wait. Bonespire is being developed by the same developers who developed Cryptmaster.

In Bonespire, you’re the powerful and reclusive wizard in his… well, his spire of bone. Anyway, it’s a puzzle crafting game where you forge magical artifacts, brew pungent potions, and cast spells with the help of your friendly, annoying imp friend. More to reveal later.

To learn more about Bonespire or Akupara Games visit:
►Bonespire: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4955170/Bonespire/
►Akupara Games: https://bio.link/akuparagames
